summary: Tested public backend APIs and desktop/mobile marketplace flows. Catalogue, search, detail tabs, cart, checkout boundary, login UI, and mobile overflow passed.

minor.issue: Returns 404; requested review flow names this slug, while seeded catalogue uses neural-notes.

integration_issues.issue: /admin and all admin subroutes render the admin dashboard without authentication or role checks; routes are client-side aliases to Dashboard(admin).
/register renders the Login component and therefore has no registration form or registration integration.

action_items: Decide whether the canonical requested detail slug is studium-labs and seed/alias it, or update the requirement to neural-notes.
Implement fail-closed Supabase session and admin-role checks for admin routes and backend admin endpoints.
Build a distinct Supabase registration flow at /register.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin protection is absent in both frontend routing and backend: GET /api/admin/overview has no authorization header or role validation.
Checkout sends a hardcoded placeholder Authorization value instead of the real Supabase session token; backend currently accepts any non-empty header and returns pending_integration.
Dashboard route variants render identical static content and sidebar buttons do not navigate.
Native select is used for sort despite design guideline requiring a dropdown component; lower priority.

success_rate.frontend: 100% core scripted checks; known contract gaps reported

seed_data_creation: No new seed data created; existing six-project seed was exercised.
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md contains no credentials, so authenticated login/admin behavior was not credential-tested.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL tested. Backend six-project catalogue, search/filter, detail, payment auth boundary, and purchases auth all passed. Browser flow passed landing -> catalogue -> search -> detail -> tab -> cart -> checkout and mobile width 390 with no overflow. Focus next retest on admin fail-closed protection, real Supabase auth, registration, and canonical detail slug.
rca of the issue: App.js defines Route elements for every admin path directly as <Dashboard admin/>, with no auth guard. The same file maps /register to <Login/>. server.py defines /api/admin/overview without authorization and project seed contains neural-notes rather than studium-labs.
